turns.reply:
The lead endpoint is 'total.backdoor' [design:d14e3d67d8d2a.endpoint_id], which uses propensity score weighting to compare units based on their treatment propensity estimated from the adjustment set [design:d14e3d67d8d2a.estimator.in_words]. Its identifying assumptions include consistency, no interference, explicit graph relationships, and that every omitted identification-relevant edge is a conditional graph assumption, not an observed absence [design:d14e3d67d8d2a.estimand.assumptions.0, design:d14e3d67d8d2a.estimand.assumptions.1, design:d14e3d67d8d2a.estimand.assumptions.2, design:d14e3d67d8d2a.estimand.assumptions.3]. It also assumes a valid propensity model and sufficient common support [design:d14e3d67d8d2a.estimator.assumes]. The symbolic estimand is the derivative of the expectation of y given c and x, with the unconfoundedness assumption that if an unobserved confounder U affects both the treated variable and y, then the probability of y given treated, c, x, and U is equal to the probability of y given treated, c, and x [design:d14e3d67d8d2a.identification_certificate.symbolic].

Other candidate designs were excluded for various reasons: 'iv.wald_late', 'mediation.linear_nie', and 'mediation.linear_nde' were excluded because they do not serve the requested target average [context.admission.endpoints.3.reason, context.admission.endpoints.8.reason, context.admission.endpoints.9.reason]. 'iv.linear_single', 'iv.linear_multiple', 'iv.linear_conditional', 'frontdoor.linear_total', and 'structural.zero' were excluded because their configurations are not activated by the supplied context [context.admission.endpoints.4.reason, context.admission.endpoints.5.reason, context.admission.endpoints.6.reason, context.admission.endpoints.7.reason, context.admission.endpoints.11.reason]. 'adjustment.linear_conditional' was excluded because it does not serve the requested target average [context.admission.endpoints.10.reason].

The artifacts for the lead endpoint show an estimated average treatment effect of 5.137751952370555 with a 95% confidence interval of 4.934846069047842 to 5.3601749844607784 [estimate:d14e3d67d8d2a.1_vs_0.value, estimate:d14e3d67d8d2a.1_vs_0.ci_low, estimate:d14e3d67d8d2a.1_vs_0.ci_high].
